helpers.name: Content filter: nudity
helpers.description: Checks every result for nudity before it is shown (safe mode) and together with the age estimate for minors.

helpers.name: Content filter: age estimate
helpers.description: Estimates the age of the faces in a result: nudity together with a likely minor is never shown.

helpers.name: LaMa (filling)
helpers.description: Fills scratches, spots and holes of old photos from their surroundings (Restore).

helpers.name: RORem (object removal)
helpers.description: Removes larger objects painted over on the Inpainting page (Remove, Auto and Thorough) and fills their place with plausible background; small ones LaMa fills. LetsThink's RORem (Apache-2.0), based on SDXL Inpainting 0.1 (CreativeML Open RAIL++-M).

helpers.name: ObjectClear (object and shadow removal)
helpers.description: Removes an object painted over on the Inpainting page together with its shadow and reflection, when chosen there; it works on the whole picture. ObjectClear (S-Lab License 1.0, non-commercial), based on SDXL Inpainting 0.1 (CreativeML Open RAIL++-M).

helpers.name: DDColor (colouring)
helpers.description: Colours black-and-white photos; the shapes stay those of the original (Restore).

helpers.name: CodeFormer (faces)
helpers.description: Restores blurred faces of old photos, with YuNet finding them (Restore). Non-commercial licence.

helpers.name: Consistency LoRA for FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (Restore)
helpers.description: Keeps FLUX.2 [klein] 4B close to the photo while it repairs: scratches go more thoroughly (Restore, option Consistency LoRA). lrzjason's LoRA, Apache-2.0.

helpers.name: Outpaint LoRA for FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (AI Canvas)
helpers.description: Lets FLUX.2 [klein] 4B extend a picture on the AI Canvas: the new part goes on with the picture's lines, light and people. fal's LoRA, Apache-2.0.

helpers.name: DWPose (pose detection)
helpers.description: Finds the pose of the people in a photo: for the Pose editor and pose control pictures.

helpers.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (depth)
helpers.description: Turns a photo into a depth map: near is light, far is dark. For depth control pictures.

helpers.name: ControlNet Union for SDXL (ProMax)
helpers.description: One model for pose, depth, edges, scribble and tile with SDXL models.

helpers.name: ControlNet Union Pro 2.0 for FLUX.1
helpers.description: Pose, depth and edges with FLUX.1 models; it reads the kind of control from the picture.

helpers.name: ControlNet pose for SD 1.5
helpers.description: The pose of a skeleton picture for SD 1.5 models.

helpers.name: ControlNet depth for SD 1.5
helpers.description: The space of a depth map for SD 1.5 models.

helpers.name: ControlNet edges for SD 1.5
helpers.description: The outlines of a picture's edges for SD 1.5 models.

helpers.name: ControlNet line art for SD 1.5
helpers.description: A line drawing coloured in by SD 1.5 models.

helpers.name: ControlNet scribble for SD 1.5
helpers.description: A rough sketch turned into a picture by SD 1.5 models.

helpers.name: ControlNet depth for SD 3.5 Medium
helpers.description: Depth maps for SD 3.5 Medium.

helpers.name: ControlNet edges for SD 3.5 Medium
helpers.description: Edges for SD 3.5 Medium.

helpers.name: ControlNet depth for SD 3.5 Large
helpers.description: Depth maps for SD 3.5 Large (needs a Hugging Face token).

helpers.name: ControlNet edges for SD 3.5 Large
helpers.description: Edges for SD 3.5 Large (needs a Hugging Face token).

helpers.name: ControlNet tile for SD 3.5 Large
helpers.description: Keeps the layout of a blurred picture and adds detail (needs a Hugging Face token).

helpers.name: QR Code Monster for SD 1.5 (Illusion)
helpers.description: Hides a pattern or text in a picture (Illusion page).

helpers.name: QR Code Monster for SDXL (Illusion)
helpers.description: Hides a pattern or text in a picture with SDXL models (Illusion page).

helpers.name: Real-ESRGAN x4plus (Upscale)
helpers.description: Enlarges pictures two or four times with detail (Upscale page, ComfyUI runtime); rebuilds soft detail of old photos (Restore).

helpers.name: FLUX 3 prompt upsampler (MLX, 4 bit)
helpers.description: Writes the full scene caption FLUX 3 Image Klein is trained on from a short prompt (Text to image, option Prompt upsampler, MLX runtime). Black Forest Labs' flux-3-image-klein-pup (Apache-2.0), quantized to 4 bit.

helpers.name: ERNIE-Image prompt enhancer (MLX)
helpers.description: Rewrites a short prompt into a rich visual description before ERNIE-Image paints it (Text to image, option Prompt enhancer, MLX runtime): Baidu's own enhancer (pe/ of ERNIE-Image-Turbo, Ministral 3 3B, Apache-2.0), loaded only for the prompt and freed again.

helpers.name: Qwen3-VL 2B (prompt from a picture)
helpers.description: Describes a picture as a prompt (Image to image, button Prompt from picture): subject, setting, light, colours, style and camera in one English paragraph. Qwen's Qwen3-VL 2B Instruct (Apache-2.0), loaded only for the picture and freed again.
